episodes.title: Lunar footprint
episodes.script: A boot pressed into the dust on the Moon. The tread left sharp ridges. With no wind to sweep them away, the marks can outlast the explorer who made them.

episodes.title: A message beneath the paint
episodes.script: A restorer lifted the frame from the painting. Under its edge, an earlier stripe of blue appeared. The hidden stripe showed where the painter had moved the horizon.

episodes.title: Saturn's rings
episodes.script: From far away, Saturn’s rings look solid. Look closer and they break into countless pieces of ice and rock. Each piece travels in its own orbit around Saturn.

episodes.title: A bent straw
episodes.script: A straw looks bent where it enters water. Light changes direction as it crosses between water and air. Your eye follows that light back in a straight line, placing the submerged straw in a different spot.
